claims.text: What the strip looks like The pacer fires despite native beats.

claims.text: Aspects (abnormal in red) Pacing spikes: fire despite native beats
claims.quote: Failure to sense (undersensing): Pacer fires despite native beats

claims.text: Spikes within QRS complexes: suggest undersensing; otherwise the ECG findings may be minimal

claims.text: Causes (mechanism and diagnoses) Mechanism: the pacemaker fails to sense native cardiac activity

claims.text: Increased stimulation threshold at the electrode site (exit block), poor lead contact, new bundle branch block, or programming problems

claims.text: Symptoms Often non-specific symptoms; the ECG changes can be subtle or absent
